about: Every record this site publishes, newest first. A date is the record's own date, or the day it was first published in this repository.

updates.title: A free model on our review bench
updates.text: On a sealed corpus of 30 real defects and 30 clean changes, MiniMax M3.1 Flash caught as many defects as Claude Opus at about 1.5 cents a review. No reviewer flags few enough clean changes to vote, and an agent-run reviewer can read its own answer key.

updates.title: Can a free model find real bugs in code it has never seen?
updates.text: MiniMax M3.1 Flash localised 63% of the bugs in our private fix history that can be found from the code alone, against 23% for our current default. Only about 1 in 10 of the fixes could be found that way.

updates.title: Where would MongoDB earn a place in Odin?
updates.text: 99,000 requests and a separate 19,800-request repeat found two advantages over monolithic JSONB, but none over the stronger PostgreSQL alternatives. All seventeen outcomes and the durability amendment are retained.

updates.title: Does flexible workflow data need MongoDB?
updates.text: Both stores passed 20,000 operations, 42 correctness checks and ten evolution suites behind Temporal activities. A MongoDB advantage remains unresolved; flexible JSON alone gives no demonstrated reason to switch.
